sites.name: Beijing South Station northern passenger entrance apron
sites.basis: Bring the adjoining ground up to the closed northern entrance and its approach, below the modeled floor.

sites.name: Beijing South Station southern passenger entrance apron
sites.basis: Seat the southern entrance crescent and the lower forecourt ramp transitions without altering the retained station datum beyond the forecourt.

sites.name: Beijing South Station platform and rail bed
sites.basis: Restore the grade below the thirteen mapped passenger islands to a continuous shallow step and keep rail lines in place.

sites.name: Beijing South Station northeast rail approaches
sites.basis: Continue the platform and track grade only under the longer northeastern termini of the mapped platforms.

notes: Local entrance grades meet the two passenger crescents. A shallow rail bed supports the thirteen platform islands and keeps the track corridors open. The forecourt station reference remains outside those grades.
